
voici le fichier jenga du projet généré; le programme c++ est celui généré par jenga apres la creation d'un nouveau projet ce programme affiche "Hello from projet salle!".

```python

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# ma salle – Jenga Workspace
# Generated by `jenga workspace` on 2026-09-23 16:56:31

from Jenga import *

with workspace("ma salle"):
    configurations(['Debug', 'Release'])
    targetoses([TargetOS.WINDOWS])
    targetarchs([TargetArch.X86_64])
    
    # Default toolchain (auto-detected)
    # usetoolchain("host-gcc")
    
    # Uncomment to use Unitest testing framework
    # with unitest() as u:
    #     u.Precompiled()
    
    # Add your projects here
    # with project("MyApp"):
    #     consoleapp()
    #     language("C++")
    #     files(["src/**.cpp"])

    # Project: projet salle
    with project("projet salle"):
        consoleapp()
        language("C++")
        cppdialect("C++17")
        location("projet salle")
        files(["src/**.cpp", "include/**.hpp"])


```
